form.label: Zeek JSON Logs - Overview
form.description: Fixture-backed Zeek JSON relay overview for conn, DNS, HTTP, SSL/TLS, notice, files, x509, SSH, DHCP, RDP, weird, software, known-hosts, Intel framework, and SMTP records. Panels use fields proven by synthetic-equivalent fixtures and Splunk JSON/search-time knowledge; this dashboard is not replay/read-back validation.

search.query: index=netids sourcetype="zeek:json" host=$host_tok$ | stats count
index=netids sourcetype="zeek:json" host=$host_tok$ zeek_log_type="notice" note=* | stats count
index=netids sourcetype="zeek:json" host=$host_tok$ zeek_log_type="http" status_code>=400 | stats count
index=netids sourcetype="zeek:json" host=$host_tok$ zeek_log_type="dns" rcode_name!="NOERROR" | stats count

panel.title: Events over time by Zeek log family

search.query: index=netids sourcetype="zeek:json" host=$host_tok$ | eval family=coalesce(zeek_log_type, log_type, "unknown") | timechart count by family

index=netids sourcetype="zeek:json" host=$host_tok$ | eval family=coalesce(zeek_log_type, log_type, "unknown"), action_or_state=coalesce(action, conn_state, method, note, family) | stats count by family action_or_state | sort -count

index=netids sourcetype="zeek:json" host=$host_tok$ | eval pair=coalesce(src_ip, src, "unknown") . " -> " . coalesce(dest_ip, dest, "unknown") | stats count by pair transport dest_port | sort -count | head 20

index=netids sourcetype="zeek:json" host=$host_tok$ zeek_log_type="conn" | table _time host uid src_ip src_port dest_ip dest_port transport service conn_state duration orig_bytes resp_bytes bytes_out bytes_in marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=netids sourcetype="zeek:json" host=$host_tok$ zeek_log_type="dns" | table _time host uid src_ip dest_ip transport dns_query dns_query_type rcode_name answers marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=netids sourcetype="zeek:json" host=$host_tok$ zeek_log_type="http" | table _time host uid src_ip dest_ip http_method host url http_status status_msg user_agent signature marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=netids sourcetype="zeek:json" host=$host_tok$ zeek_log_type="ssl" | table _time host uid src_ip dest_ip tls_sni tls_version cipher established validation_status subject issuer marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=netids sourcetype="zeek:json" host=$host_tok$ zeek_log_type="notice" | table _time host uid note msg src_ip src_port dest_ip dest_port action signature actions suppress_for marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=netids sourcetype="zeek:json" host=$host_tok$ zeek_log_type="files" | table _time host file_id file_name file_mime_type file_seen_bytes file_total_bytes file_md5 src_ip dest_ip signature marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=netids sourcetype="zeek:json" host=$host_tok$ (zeek_log_type="x509" OR zeek_log_type="ssh") | table _time host zeek_log_type uid x509_id x509_subject x509_issuer x509_serial ssh_auth_success ssh_client ssh_server ssh_cipher_alg ssh_host_key_alg src_ip dest_ip marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=netids sourcetype="zeek:json" host=$host_tok$ zeek_log_type="dhcp" | table _time host dhcp_client_addr dhcp_server_addr dhcp_mac dhcp_host_name dhcp_assigned_addr dhcp_msg_types src_ip dest_ip action signature marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=netids sourcetype="zeek:json" host=$host_tok$ zeek_log_type="rdp" | table _time host uid src_ip src_port dest_ip dest_port rdp_cookie rdp_result rdp_security_protocol rdp_client_name action signature marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

panel.title: Weird activity, software, host inventory, and Intel matches

search.query: index=netids sourcetype="zeek:json" host=$host_tok$ (zeek_log_type="weird" OR zeek_log_type="software" OR zeek_log_type="known_hosts" OR zeek_log_type="intel") | table _time host zeek_log_type uid src_ip src_port dest_ip dest_port weird_name weird_addl weird_notice weird_source software_host software_port software_type software_name software_version known_host intel_indicator intel_indicator_type intel_seen_where intel_matched_types intel_sources action signature marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=netids sourcetype="zeek:json" host=$host_tok$ zeek_log_type="smtp" | table _time host uid src_ip src_port dest_ip dest_port smtp_helo smtp_mailfrom smtp_rcptto smtp_subject smtp_last_reply user_agent path action signature marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=netids sourcetype="zeek:json" host=$host_tok$ | eval family=coalesce(zeek_log_type, log_type, "unknown") | stats count dc(marker) as fixture_markers values(family) as families values(transport) as transports min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by index sourcetype source host | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort -count

index=netids sourcetype="zeek:json" host=$host_tok$ | table _time host sourcetype source vendor product zeek_log_type uid src_ip src_port dest_ip dest_port transport action signature signature_id dns_query http_method http_status tls_sni tls_version file_id file_name file_mime_type x509_subject x509_issuer ssh_auth_success ssh_client ssh_server dhcp_client_addr dhcp_assigned_addr rdp_result rdp_security_protocol weird_name weird_addl software_name software_version known_host intel_indicator intel_indicator_type intel_seen_where smtp_helo smtp_mailfrom smtp_rcptto smtp_subject smtp_last_reply marker _raw | sort -_time | head 50
